jobs.title: Lead Instructor, EMEA
jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. About TRM TRM Labs is on a mission to build a safer world by fighting crime and protecting the people who investigate it. We started as a blockchain intelligence company, helping law enforcement, government agencies, financial institutions, and businesses detect, investigate, and disrupt crypto-enabled crime. Today our platform reaches well beyond the blockchain: we fuse on-chain data with cyber and open-source intelligence (OSINT) so investigators can move from a single crypto address to the full story behind a criminal network. Our blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms turn fragmented signals into fast, defensible investigative leads for the teams protecting public safety and national security every day. TRM Academy delivers training and certification for the global community of investigators, analysts, and compliance professionals who detect and prevent fraud and financial crime involving cryptocurrencies. Learners get live and virtual courses, practical exercises, and a community of the world's experts in blockchain, crypto compliance, and financial crime investigations. About the Role As the Lead Instructor, EMEA , you will own the design and delivery of TRM Academy training across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, with blockchain intelligence and crypto investigations at the core of what you teach. You will turn complex on-chain concepts into practical, mission-ready skills for law enforcement, national security, and government audiences, and you will be equally comfortable teaching crypto businesses, exchanges, and financial institutions. jobs.description: Bimbel One adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang pendidikan untuk membantu siswa-siswi mencapai hasil yang terbaik. Sejak berdiri, Bimbel One memiliki budaya The Champion Tradition. Banyak siswa yang setelah bergabung dengan Bimbel One mengalami perubahan positif dan menjadi yang terbaik di sekolah-sekolah unggulan. Dalam rangka untuk membantu lebih banyak siswa, Bimbel One membutuhkan individu-individu berkualitas, yang memiliki passion pada dunia pendidikan, untuk bergabung menjadi Guru Matematika SMP / SMA.
